name: Coefficient-Space Realizability Criterion
statement: The coefficient space $\mathcal A(C)$ is nonempty exactly when $C$ is ample and affine-convex realizable. In that case it contains rational rows with rational strict witnesses, and an open polyhedral cone realizes $C$.
proof: A feasible row family defines the cone cut out by its strict separator inequalities. Conversely, separate a convex realization from each minimal missing cylinder; minimality makes every supported coefficient positive. Convex projection proves ampleness, and strict rational approximation supplies rational data.
